name: Cisco ASA — VPN Login From ≥2 Distinct IPs for Same User
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = cisco_asa_raw
| filter cisco_asa_raw._raw_log contains "113039"
| filter xdm.source.user.username != null and xdm.source.ipv4 != null
| alter ip_16 = arrayindex(regextract(xdm.source.ipv4, "^(\d+\.\d+)\."), 0)
| filter ip_16 != null
| comp count_distinct(xdm.source.ipv4) as ips,
       count_distinct(ip_16) as distinct_networks,
       values(xdm.source.ipv4) as ip_list
       by xdm.source.user.username
| filter distinct_networks >= 2 and ips >= 2
| fields ip_list, xdm.source.user.username
description: ASA 113039 AnyConnect parent session start events for the same xdm.source.user.username from ≥2 distinct source IPs within 30 minutes — impossible travel via VPN.
alert_name: Cisco ASA — VPN Login From ≥2 Distinct IPs for Same User
